scope: Backend responsibility folders in all production modules and tests
checks: No loose production Java classes at module, layer, application operation or persistence container roots
Explicit domain responsibilities and application leaf responsibilities
Equivalent structural rules for test sources
Tests named after production classes remain in the production responsibility package or a narrower child test role
Negative and positive path fixtures, including create/from_quote/request and repository/entity roles
accepted_leaves: Existing infrastructure responsibilities, application ports/in|out, global architecture suites and shared DTO responsibility remain valid leaves; CashlyApplication is the sole production bootstrap root exception.

negative_mutation.description: In an isolated container copy, physically moved orders/domain/entity/Order.java back to orders/domain/Order.java after compilation, then invoked surefire:test without recompilation.

restored_positive.description: Restored entity/Order.java in the same isolated copy and reran the five guard tests.

limitations: The mutation run scanned a migrated production snapshot and only the new guard test source, not the complete historical pre-migration source tree.
The matching-test guard was subsequently refined to permit narrower child test roles such as request/validation. The final full isolated suite must validate the final source revision.
These structural tests use filesystem reads only; no development database operations were performed.
review_findings_resolved_by_migration: Inline fully qualified class references require relocation alongside imports.
InvoiceIssuanceArchitectureTest reads a literal validator source path and requires the new validation role path.
Existing wildcard imports must not expand to inaccessible test classes during package relocation.
Global loose infrastructure test helpers, request UnitTest variants and domain counterpart tests require explicit mirrored roles.
Duplicate request validation suites can retain class names under the narrower request/validation test role.
